```mermaid

    a["Standard Adaptive Alloy"]:::current
    b["T2 Adaptive Alloy"]:::prod
    a --> b
    click b "/ja/content/items/named1-adaptive-alloy/" "T2 Adaptive Alloy"
    c["T2 Adaptive Alloy Pr"]:::prod
    a --> c
    click c "/ja/content/items/named1-adaptive-alloy-pr/" "T2 Adaptive Alloy Pr"
    classDef current fill:#2f9e6f,stroke:#1f6f4a,color:#ffffff
    classDef prod fill:#3b6ea5,stroke:#274a75,color:#ffffff
    classDef more fill:#39445a,stroke:#54658a,color:#d5dbe8
```
